1413934.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Provides extensive illuminated coverage with 200 warm white LEDs, perfect for decorating fences, pergolas, patios, shrubs and garden seating areas
- Choose between static and flashing light functions using the convenient switch located beneath the solar panel, allowing you to create the perfect outdoor ambience
- Built-in light sensors automatically switch the lights on at night and off during daylight hours for effortless, energy-efficient operation
- Charges during the day using sunlight and delivers up to 8 hours of illumination each evening, eliminating the need for mains power or replacement batteries
- Features a 2m cable between the ground stake and first LED, enabling optimal solar panel positioning

## Information
Add a charming warm white glow to your outdoor spaces with this set of 12m 200 LED Solar Powered Garden String Lights. Ideal for decorating trees, shrubs, fences, patios and pergolas, these versatile solar lights combine attractive illumination with hassle-free operation. These lights offer an easy way to create a relaxing atmosphere for outdoor dining, entertaining and everyday garden enjoyment. The set features 200 warm white LEDs positioned along a dark green cable, helping the lights blend naturally into garden foliage, hedges and outdoor displays. The 12m illuminated length provides excellent coverage for decorating pathways, seating areas, gazebos and garden borders. Powered by solar energy, the solar panel charges during daylight hours and automatically switches the lights on at dusk. Once fully charged, the lights remain illuminated for up to 8 hours, allowing you to enjoy beautiful outdoor lighting without the need for mains power or batteries. The string lights offer both static and flashing light functions. Simply use the black switch underneath the solar panel to select your preferred lighting effect. The 2m cable length between the ground stake and the first light provides flexible positioning of the solar panel for optimal sunlight exposure while allowing the lights to be placed exactly where needed.

- Flexible strong weatherproof cable easy install

## Features
- Compact 100cm maypole tree for indoor and outdoor festive displays
- 146 LEDs across eight light strings and an illuminated star topper
- White, warm white, or multi-colour LEDs with eight modes and memory
- Battery powered with timer; requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
- Ready-assembled base and four ground stakes for secure lawn display

## Information
Bring an eye-catching festive glow to your home or garden with the Christow Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Standing 100cm tall, it has eight illuminated strings arranged beneath a glowing star to create a classic tree-shaped silhouette. Choose white, warm white, or multi-colour micro LEDs to match your Christmas theme, with eight light modes adding variety to the display. Requiring no mains socket, it’s easy to position on a lawn, patio, entranceway, or inside your home. Classic Maypole Silhouette Eight strings sweep from the illuminated star topper down to the base, creating an enchanting maypole tree silhouette. ## Information
Lumineo micro wire tree lights warm white 2.1 M. This set of 672 warm white LED lights are strung on a silver wire, which is delicate and flexible. This wire can be easily shaped and moulded to fit your specific decorating needs, whether it's wrapping around a tree branch or draping along a centrepiece. The silver wire adds a touch of elegance to the lights and allows them to blend seamlessly with a variety of decor styles. The specially designed micro wire tree lights are designed for use with a 7ft 210cm Christmas tree. A hanging loop is included which hooks over the top of your tree. The lights feature 16 strings each with a length of 2.1M which hang freely vertically down your Christmas tree. The steady on warm white colour of the lights creates a cozy and intimate ambiance. It's ideal for enhancing the warmth and charm of holiday decor or adding an elegant touch to special events. Warm white is a classic and timeless color that complements a wide range of decor styles and color schemes. The lights feature an 8m lead cable from transformer and are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, these eco friendly LED lights are the perfect addition to lighting up your tree or garden during this festive season. Saving you 90% on energy costs to! (Transformer must be located indoors or in a weatherproof box).
